description: Do something in a system the owner connected (ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira, Zendesk, Zabbix, PagerDuty, Slack, AWS, vSphere, GitHub, Twilio, Salesforce, HubSpot, Shopify, Stripe): create or update a ticket, acknowledge an alert, start or reboot an instance, move a deal, send a text, refund an order. Give the action kind (from list_actions), its params and a one-line reason. Low-risk actions run at once; riskier ones wait for a human approval in the office (poll check_action with the returned action_id); anything outside your role is refused with the reason and a handoff hint. Set dry_run to preview what would change without changing it.

agent_id.description: Only with a workspace-level token: which bot is acting.

connection_id.description: Which connection to use when the workspace has several of the same kind (con_...).

correlation_id.description: External id (ticket, alert, conversation) that joins this action to its events.

dry_run.description: Preview only: the connector reports what would change and changes nothing.

kind.description: Action kind, e.g. servicenow.incident.create or aws.ec2.start_instance (see list_actions).

params.description: The action's parameters as named by list_actions; unknown keys are refused.

reason.description: Why you want this, in one line (shown to the approver). At most 240 characters.

run_id.description: The run this action belongs to (same run_id you report with report_to_office).

name: perform_action
title: Perform action
